items.text: Tampa Bay (final report): OUT: WR Emeka Egbuka (foot). QUESTIONABLE: RT Luke Goedeke (calf), RB Kenny Gainwell (hip). Baker Mayfield (right thumb) practiced fully all week, without his protective glove Friday, and has no designation.

Atlanta (Saturday update): OUT: RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring), LB Divine Deablo (forearm) and DB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE: DE Samson Ebukam, WR Olamide Zaccheaus, CB Avieon Terrell (illness), LB Charles Snowden. G Chris Lindstrom missed Friday (personal) with no designation. DE James Pearce Jr. serves the last game of his suspension.
